blocks.text: Kisi saada mixture se aik ya do components alag karne ke liye saade tareeqe kaafi hain, jaise filtration (chhaanna), distillation (ubaal kar bhaap ko dobara liquid banana) aur solvent extraction (solvent ke zariye nikalna). Lekin complex (bohat si cheezon wale) mixtures ke liye zyada advanced tareeqe chahiye. Chromatography aik versatile (bohat kaam aane wala) aur ahem analytical technique (cheezon ki pehchan aur jaanch ka tareeqa) hai. Is se chemists complex mixture ke har component ko alag kar lete hain, is buniyad par ke har component do mukhtalif phases ki taraf kitni affinity (kashish, lagao) rakhta hai. Khilte phoolon ke rang (dyes), kisi jheel ya darya ke paani mein pollutants (gandagi), ya paudon ke patton se nikle medicinal extracts (dawai wale arq) jaise complex mixtures chromatography se alag kiye ja sakte hain. Chromatography se cheezon ki identification (pehchan), purification (khalis karna) aur quantification (miqdar napna) bohat precision (durusti) se hoti hai. Is liye yeh medicine, forensic science, environmental science waghera mein aik behtareen modern (jadeed) analytical tool hai.

blocks.text: Patte ke hare extract (arq) mein kai rang (pigments) mile hote hain. Har pigment stationary aur mobile phase se mukhtalif had tak juda rehta hai, is liye har aik mukhtalif unchai tak jata aur alag patti (band) banata hai.

blocks.title: Stationary aur mobile phase kya hain?
blocks.text: Chromatography mein do phases hote hain. Stationary phase woh hai jo apni jagah tika rehta hai (koi solid, ya solid par laga hua liquid, jaise kaghaz mein paani). Mobile phase woh hai jo us ke oopar se ya andar se guzarta hai (liquid solvent ya gas). Jo component mobile phase ko zyada pasand kare woh zyada door ya zyada tez chalta hai.

Adsorption aik surface phenomenon (sirf surface yani satah par hone wala process) hai jis mein particles (zarre) sirf bahar ki surface par jama hote hain. Maslan activated charcoal gases aur impurities (gandagi) ko apni surface par jama kar leta hai; isi liye yeh filters aur purification (safai) systems mein istemal hota hai. Chromatography ki bohat si qismon mein se teen ahem qismein yeh hain:

blocks.prompt: Chromatography mein mixture ka har component kitna door jata hai, yeh kis cheez par depend karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Is par ke woh stationary aur mobile phase ki taraf kitni affinity (kashish) rakhta hai: jo mobile phase ko jitna zyada pasand kare, woh utna door (ya utna tez) chalta hai.

items: Saade mixtures ke liye filtration, distillation, solvent extraction; complex mixtures ke liye chromatography.
Chromatography do phases (stationary aur mobile) ki taraf mukhtalif kashish se components alag karti hai.
Adsorption: particles sirf bahar ki surface par jama hote hain (jaise activated charcoal).
Teen ahem qismein: paper (PC), thin layer (TLC), gas (GC).
